design_clause: G3 — the distractor set (the C-V4 lesson). A preregistered set of sentence pairs that differ in meaning and must not collapse to one interpretation.
voiding_sentence_verbatim: if the proposer maps a distractor pair to the same query above the registered floor, the design is measuring the verifier's tolerance and not the proposal, and the reading is void.
floor_meaning: ZERO pairs may collapse. A rate would invite a budget; a collapsed pair is the design measuring the wrong thing, and one is enough to mean it.
committed_before: the proposer, the candidate enumerator, and any model call from this lane.

the_clause_C_V4_dropped_and_this_set_car.what_went_wrong_last_time: ROADMAP-v0.20:102-110 records that C-V4′ exists because C-V4 'never establishes that the mutation should have moved' what it measured. A control that only checks that two things came out the same has not established that they should have come out different.
the_clause_C_V4_dropped_and_this_set_car.so_before_any_scoring: every pair is checked BY EXACT CODE to resolve to two DIFFERENT verified queries. A pair that does not is EXCLUDED from the denominator, and the exclusion is counted and published.
the_clause_C_V4_dropped_and_this_set_car.why_that_matters_here: if a pair's two sentences do not actually denote different registered queries, then a proposer mapping them to one query is CORRECT, and scoring it as a collapse would be scoring the set's own defect as the model's.
the_clause_C_V4_dropped_and_this_set_car.and_one_pair_is_expected_to_be_excluded: pair d03 names de Morgan in the logic corpus and in the set-theory corpus. P2 measured that those two land in the SAME twin group, so they may well fail the pre-check. It is left in the set deliberately: a set that quietly dropped its hardest pair before running would be a set chosen to read well, and an exclusion the pre-check makes is an exclusion a reader can see.
